public_rationale: Primary reports document illegal chess moves in 2023 and again in January 2025. The latter includes DeepSeek-R1, so the problem clearly extended beyond ChatGPT. This supports the ordinary behavioral reading of the sentence. It does not establish the preceding claim that absent world models caused those failures.
limitations: The decisive reports come from the same investigator.
The result establishes recurrence, not prevalence across all LLMs.
The 2023 report also describes stronger performance by another model; that does not negate persistence of failures.
If the sentence is read as asserting persistent absence of internal world models, that stronger interpretation remains unresolved.
